# Queenstown Constituency

Queenstown Constituency was a constituency in Singapore. It used to exist from 1955 to 1988, where it was absorbed into Brickworks GRC.
History
In 1988, the constituency was merged into Brickworks GRC following the establishment of Group representation constituency (GRC) and Single Member Constituency (SMC).
